The argument

Why decisions, not data, are the bottleneck

Four chapters, one claim: the team that corrects fastest wins the quarter.

01

The stack grew, the clarity didn't

Growth-stage teams run 5 to 15 tools that don't talk to each other in plain language. More data, same decisions.

02

Dashboards show symptoms, not causes

A chart can show the drop. It cannot tell you whether the cause is creative fatigue, a tracking error, or a competitor.

03

Speed of correction wins

The decisive variable is no longer launch quality, it's how fast you correct. Days versus minutes compounds every quarter.

04

Memory is the moat

Every decision and outcome I record makes the next recommendation sharper. That compounding belongs to your organisation.
